channel.title: Letters from Andrew Ng
channel.description: Personal messages to the AI community from Andrew Ng

item.title: That Feeling Of Job Insecurity (And What You Can Do About It): In times of economic and technological uncertainty, build on things that tend to remain stable. Community and skills are likely to weather shifts in business and society.
item.description: I’ve been hearing from people at all levels of seniority about a feeling of job insecurity.

item.title: How Anti-AI Propaganda Hurts the Public: The anti-AI coalition is beoming more sophisticated in its efforts to block progress
item.description: The anti-AI coalition continues to maneuver to find arguments to slow down AI progress.

item.title: Building Voice-Enabled Apps is Easier Than You May Think: Voice-enabled AI applications are improving quickly. Get ready for the next wave of AI!
item.description: Voice-based AI that you can talk to is improving rapidly, yet most people still don’t appreciate how pervasive voice UIs (user interfaces) will become.

item.title: Open Questions About the Future of Software Engineering: The future of software engineering — the theme of our AI Developer Conference April 28-29 in San Francisco — is in flux. Here are some top open questions.
item.description: As AI agents accelerate coding, what is the future of software engineering?

item.title: AI-Native Software Development Needs Generalists: As AI accelerates software development, teammates must play a wider variey of roles
item.description: AI-native software engineering teams operate very differently than traditional teams.

item.title: Coding Agents Accelerate Some Software Tasks More Than Others: Knowing how much coding agents accelerate different software-development tasks can help you put together the fastest teams
item.description: Coding agents are accelerating different types of software work to different degrees.

item.title: Learn foundational prompting techniques in AI Prompting For Everyone!: Whatever your skill level, AI Prompting For Everyone teaches the best ways to prompt ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other models.
item.description: The ways we prompt AI are very different in 2026 than 2022 when ChatGPT came out.

item.title: AI Will Not Destroy the Job Market: Here's why fear of an AI “jobpocaypse” is overblown.
item.description: There will be no AI jobpocalypse.

item.title: Speak With AI Andrew!: Andrew Ng built a voice-to-voice AI avatar shaped by his personality. You can use it to discuss whatever is on your mind.
item.description: We’ve been working on AI Andrew, an AI companion shaped by my personality.

item.title: Why Giving More Students A's Can Be a Good Thing: Harvard wants to award fewer A’s to counter grade inflation, but education should be about helping students succeed.
item.description: Harvard University just voted to limit the number of A grades given in undergraduate classes to about 20% of the class.

item.title: Forward Deployed Engineers and the Future of AI Engineering
item.description: One of the new, buzzy jobs in Silicon Valley is the AI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), an engineer who is embedded within a client organization to help customize solutions, such as building and tuning agentic workflows that suit the client’s particular needs.

item.title: AI Regulations Must Balance Innovation and Risk
item.description: There have been intense efforts over the past few years to lobby governments to pass AI laws for regulatory capture or to suppress open source.

item.title: Agents on the Desktop
item.description: If you haven’t already, I encourage you to experiment with using AI agents not just to chat but to actually do work for you on your desktop.

item.title: Open Platforms Beat Power Plays
item.description: Over the last two weeks, both the U.S. Government and Anthropic took significant actions that demonstrated their power to control access to AI by restricting what others can do with frontier models.

item.title: Three Key Loops for Building Great Software
item.description: AI-assisted agentic coding reinforces iterative software development. These three loops can guide development and help you decide what to build.
